name: Creamy Chicken Salad with Avocado & Artichoke Hearts
instructions: Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat chicken dry with paper towels and cut into bite-sized pieces.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add chicken, salt, and pepper; cook stirring occasionally, until golden and cooked through, 3-4 minutes. Remove to a plate and set aside to cool, 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash, dry, zest and juice lemon into a medium bowl. Add mayo, Dijon, and spices, then whisk to combine the dressing.
Drain artichoke hearts. Using a clean cutting board, roughly chop artichokes and add to the bowl with the dressing.
Wash, dry, halve, and pit avocado; using a spoon, scoop out the flesh and medium dice. Add to the bowl, along with the cooled chicken, and stir to combine the chicken salad.
To serve, divide chicken salad between plates or bowls and enjoy!
author: Mealime
